jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a senior-level backend engineer to join our growing Engineering team in TLV.

This role will require you to bring features to the finish line while collaborating closely with other developers, as well as with the Product, QA, Data, and Machine Learning  teams—all with the goal of delivering a seamless, joyful experience for our customers.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you’ll:

  • Help build our products using microservices written in Typescript (using NestJS).

  • Leverage our in-house autonomous tools to manage all development flow, from setting up our development environment to creating git branches and deploying services to production

  • Collaborate closely with the Product team, in a self-sufficient squad to achieve the squad’s OKRs

  • Be the owner of your domain to ensure code quality, performance, and scalability of our products

  • Coach and mentor other developers and help them elevate their skills

What you’ll need:

  • 6+ years working as a backend engineer

  • BSc in Computer Science or Mathematics (or equivalent experience)

  • Passionate about technology

  • Broad knowledge of modern backend frameworks, tools, and architecture

  • Experience working on high scale, production-grade projects

  • Past contributions to open source projects are a plus

  • Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Senior Growth Product Manager with a passion for experimentation, data-driven decision-making, and creating seamless user experiences. You’ll join one of our high-impact growth teams, helping drive user acquisition, engagement, retention, and cross-sell opportunities.

This role has the potential to unlock massive revenue growth - scaling from millions to billions. You’ll define and implement strategies that drive measurable impact, using deep customer insights, A/B testing, and iterative experimentation to fuel sustainable growth.

As a strategic leader, you’ll set the vision for where we need to go and craft the roadmap to get us there - balancing business goals with customer needs.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Own and execute key parts of our growth strategy, from research to launch, focusing on user acquisition, retention, and monetization

  • Understand customer behavior and pain points, leveraging data, user research, and experimentation to uncover opportunities

  • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and continuously optimize for impact

  • Lead continuous A/B testing and experimentation, using insights to drive iterative improvements

  • Work cross-functionally with Design, Engineering, Data Science, and Marketing to bring growth ideas to life

  • Challenge assumptions and rethink the status quo, pushing for bold, innovative approaches to growth

What You’ll Need

  • 6+ years of experience as a product manager in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment

  • Deep expertise in growth methodologies, including A/B testing, conversion optimization, and engagement strategies

  • A data-first mindset, with strong analytical skills and experience leveraging insights to inform decisions

  • End-to-end product execution skills, from strategy and ideation to implementation and optimization

  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels

  • A hands-on, proactive mindset - you’re not afraid to dive in and make things happen

  • Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - ML Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Backend Engineer to help build and scale the Machine Learning Platform that powers how Lemonade uses AI across the business. You'll be part of the ML Platform team, designing the infrastructure that lets our data scientists move faster, ship smarter, and operate with confidence in production.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work. Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Design and build the foundational ML platform and AI agents to accelerate data science model delivery across all business units

  • Architect cloud-native microservices running on Kubernetes, using infrastructure-as-code to automate model deployment and management

  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle, covering training, testing, deployment, and real-time monitoring

  • Evaluate and choose the right tools and technologies based on workload demands and performance requirements

  • Collaborate with engineering, data science, and product teams to keep ML projects aligned with business goals

  • Identify and fix reliability, scalability, and performance gaps before they become problems

What you'll need

  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong record of delivering high-scale, production-grade systems

  • Strong proficiency in Python

  • Hands-on experience with relational and NoSQL databases, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

  • Experience with training, testing, deploying, and monitoring real-time or near real-time ML models in production

  • Fluent with AI-powered development tools like Cursor and Claude Code, and genuinely curious about what's next in GenAI, LLMs, and AI agents

  • Familiarity with AI concepts like RAG, embeddings, mixture-of-experts, prompt crafting, and LLM context engineering - an advantage

  • Sharp problem-solving instincts and the ability to move fast without cutting corners

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field

  • Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Claims Experience
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who’s experienced in planning, designing, and scaling world-class products. If you love tackling complex problems, cherish the power of automation and self-service, enjoy exploring the latest GenAI models, and are passionate about designing amazing customer experiences at scale, this one’s for you.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you’ll:

In your day-to-day, you’ll be responsible to drive Lemonade’s automation efforts to the next level, to allow us to reach infinite scale. Our efforts are focused on automating all of the touch points we have with our customers— including handling their claims, replying to their questions to customer support, and reviewing risk factors. By doing so, we optimize our operational efficiency and drive delightful customer experience.

  • You’ll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, data analysts, and stakeholders within our Customer Ops team. 

  • With an in-depth knowledge of Lemonade’s customer-facing teams, products, and brand, you’ll create product strategies consistent with the company’s vision, and translate them into detailed requirements and prototypes. 

  • You’ll prioritize tasks as needed, and come up with creative new ideas to expand our product functions, and improve scalability and automation efforts.

What you’ll need:

  • At least 5 years experience working as a product manager in a successful startup / fast-growing company - a must

  • Hands on experience with building GenAI applications - a must

  • Capable of understanding complex processes, and identifying areas calling for improvement

  • Experience with automating manual processes - a big plus

  • Self-organized, process driven

  • Data-driven and analytical thinker

  • Fully fluent in English, with top-notch communication skills

  • Experience leading small, agile teams

  • Self-learning individual who reads constantly and loves to pass on their knowledge to others

  • Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

  • Enthusiasm about learning and adapting to the exciting world of AI –  a commitment to exploring this field is a fundamental part of our culture

jobs.title: Associate General Counsel, Securities & Corporate Legal
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a senior corporate lawyer to help Lemonade navigate the legal complexities of being a public, high-growth company at the intersection of insurance and AI. Reporting into our CLO, this role sits at the center of Lemonade's Legal team, partnering directly with executive leadership and the Board on everything from capital markets and M&A to corporate governance and commercial strategy.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

We’ve been AI-native since 2015. We're building the future of insurance with AI at its core, and we love people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Lead legal support for capital markets activities, including equity offerings, debt issuances, and capital management initiatives

  • Advise management and the Board on SEC, NYSE, and other securities law requirements, including periodic reporting, insider trading compliance, Regulation FD, and Rule 10b5-1 plans

  • Manage disclosure controls and procedures, proxy statements, Form 4 filings, and investor communications

  • Drive legal execution of acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures, and strategic investments, including due diligence, transaction structuring, and negotiation

  • Oversee significant commercial agreements, vendor contracts, and strategic partnerships, while building scalable contracting processes and templates

  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on corporate governance matters, fiduciary duties, and delegations of authority

  • Support Board and committee meetings as Assistant Corporate Secretary, and monitor regulatory and legislative developments across our operating jurisdictions

What you'll need

  • 10+ years of relevant legal experience at a nationally recognized law firm and/or public company legal department

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and admission to practice in at least one U.S. jurisdiction in good standing

  • Deep expertise in securities law, public company reporting, SOX compliance, and corporate governance

  • Proven M&A and strategic transaction experience, including cross-functional project management and coordination of outside counsel

  • Strong contract negotiation and drafting skills, with experience advising senior executives, boards, and audit committees

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI-powered legal tools, and a track record of building or improving legal workflows with technology

  • Ready to work in our NYC office 3 days per week

Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Lemonade's US base salary range for this full-time position is $250,000 - $275,000 plus equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our competitive total rewards package includes comprehensive health & wellness coverage, equity, a 401(k) plan with employer match, 20 paid vacation days, and parental leave. Speak to your recruiter to hear more about the specific salary range for your preferred location and our total rewards package.

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager, Car
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for an Insurance Product Manager to help build the most loved car insurance on the planet. You'll be part of the Insurance Product team, working closely with Actuarial, Insurance Operations, and Underwriting to grow Lemonade Car profitably — shaping coverage, pricing, and the product roadmap that drives it all forward. From connected cars to rating plan sophistication, you'll own meaningful work that moves the product and the business.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Develop new car products that meet the needs of emerging customer segments — including connected and autonomously driven cars

  • Advance our countrywide Car strategy through forms, coverages, policy language, and rating plan improvements that keep our protection cutting-edge

  • Partner with Actuarial and Underwriting to develop coverage, pricing, and eligibility requirements that balance innovation with financial soundness

  • Build product specification documents, define project requirements, and work with the Product team to prioritize and ship features that make a real difference for customers

  • Collaborate with Insurance Operations to move product changes through regulatory approval and into production — smoothly and fast

  • Research distribution channels, market trends, and competitor moves, turning findings into recommendations that grow the business

  • Measure the impact of product changes to support smarter decisions and ensure the product keeps evolving in the right direction

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of P&C experience, with at least 5 years in personal lines insurance product development, product management, or state management

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Insurance, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related field

  • Strong analytical skills and sharp attention to detail — you identify trends early and turn them into action

  • A strategic, ownership-driven mindset — you challenge the status quo and bring creative solutions to the table

  • Strong technical skills — SQL, Python, Looker, or similar tools, including experience building dashboards or reports, preferred

  • Solid Microsoft Office or Google Suite skills

  • Excellent organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex priorities in a fast-moving environment

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, and a natural collaborator across teams

  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and a real commitment to growing alongside these tools — it's core to how we work here

  • Ability to work in a remote environment

Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants from these states: Alaska, California, Colorado, Montana, Hawaii, New Mexico and Puerto Rico.

Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our competitive total rewards package includes comprehensive health & wellness coverage, equity, a 401(k) plan with employer match, 20 paid vacation days, and parental leave. jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Growth Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Lemonade transformed insurance by replacing legacy processes with automation and machine learning. On the Growth Platform team, you will architect and build a brand-new growth engine: an event-driven platform that ingests customer signals from across our ecosystem to power intelligent decision-making across all customer touchpoints.

You'll have full architectural ownership of the services and data pipelines that evaluate user context, trigger outreach, and directly influence company growth.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Architect, build, and scale backend services that ingest and unify customer data from multiple sources into actionable signals for personalization, recommendations, and lifecycle journeys.

  • Design the decision engines and business logic that orchestrate outreach across communication channels, integrating experimentation frameworks and machine learning models.

  • Partner with product, data, and machine learning colleagues to turn customer insight into features people actually use.

  • Own your services end to end, from code quality and performance to reliability after launch.

  • Spot gaps in how we serve customers and drive the fix yourself.

  • Drive engineering excellence - Mentor engineers and help shape the engineering roadmap of the team as the team grows.

What you'll need

  • 7+ years building production backend systems that run at scale.

  • A track record of taking a problem from definition to a shipped, running solution with little day-to-day direction.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern backend language, plus proof you pick up new stacks and tools quickly.

  • A product mindset: you can explain why your work matters to customers and to the business.

  • A BSc in Computer Science, Mathematics, or equivalent experience.

  • Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

  • Bonus points for

    • TypeScript and NestJS, customer lifecycle or CRM data, recommendation systems or experimentation platforms, or open-source contributions.

    • Experience with customer lifecycle systems, customer data platforms (CDP), or dynamic experimentation frameworks.

    • Experience integrating machine learning model outputs or predictive scores into backend workflows.

    • Active contributions to open-source software.

  • Sign strategic partnerships across the multifamily ecosystem — national property managers, REITs and asset owners, and proptech platforms — to drive national distribution of Lemonade Renters, Pet, Car, and Homeowners products

  • Define and execute our multifamily go-to-market strategy, including partner segmentation, commercial model, and channel playbook, working closely with senior leadership

You'll lead both the technology and the business coordination for our data warehouse — architecting scalable solutions while working closely with stakeholders and data providers to ensure our platform serves the entire organization's needs. We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Lead technical architecture — design and develop scalable data warehouse solutions that support multiple products and serve the entire organization's analytics needs

  • Manage the technical roadmap — set strategy and guide execution for the Data Warehouse team, ensuring our platform evolves with business requirements

  • Drive business process coordination — translate business needs into technical requirements while establishing clear data contracts with R&D, Analytics, and external data providers

  • Establish and implement best practices — set technical standards for data warehouse architecture, performance tuning, and development methodologies that guide the entire team's approach to building scalable data solutions

  • 7+ years as a BI Engineer or Data Engineer, with 2+ in a technical leadership or architect role

jobs.title: Senior Car Insurance Pricing Expert
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior Car Insurance Pricing Expert to help shape how Lemonade prices risk across our global business, from our Tel Aviv office.

This isn't a traditional actuarial role. You'll sit at the intersection of Insurance, Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Business Strategy on our Insurance team, owning hard pricing and risk-management problems end to end. That means finding opportunities, designing better approaches, building scalable tools with technical teams, and turning insights into decisions that move growth, profitability, and risk selection forward.

You might be a trained actuary, a pricing leader, a decision scientist, or a technically strong insurance operator who's built serious pricing capabilities. Formal credentials are a plus, but they're not the point. The point is whether you can use data, insurance intuition, statistical rigor, and AI-enabled tools to solve complex pricing problems better and faster than the industry standard.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Own and evolve core components of Lemonade's Car pricing strategy, bringing analytical rigor and product-minded creativity to how we price risk

  • Identify high-leverage opportunities across rating, underwriting, segmentation, risk selection, growth, profitability, and portfolio management

  • Build, evaluate, and improve Car pricing and risk models using actuarial methods, machine learning, AI-enabled workflows, and strong business judgment

  • Partner with Data Science, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Growth to turn pricing ideas into scalable capabilities

  • Translate complex pricing problems into clear product and platform requirements, helping teams build internal tools that make better decisions faster

  • Define and track key metrics - loss ratio, rate adequacy, conversion, retention, segmentation lift, and model performance - to keep decisions grounded in real impact

  • Make complex actuarial and pricing concepts clear and actionable for technical and non-technical audiences alike, and help build pricing acumen across the Tel Aviv team

What you'll need

  • 8+ years of experience in Car insurance pricing, actuarial science, decision science, risk analytics, or a closely related field

  • A proven track record solving complex pricing, underwriting, segmentation, or risk-management problems with measurable business impact

  • Strong analytical instincts - knowing how to find signal in data, make decisions under uncertainty, and separate elegant analysis from useful analysis

  • Hands-on fluency with modern analytical tools, agentic AI capabilities, and code - including experience using generative AI, coding agents, or advanced automation to materially improve analytical workflows

  • Solid understanding of Car insurance pricing fundamentals, including rating plans, loss costs, rate adequacy, segmentation, model validation, telematics and financial performance.

  • Familiarity with predictive modeling methods such as GLMs, gradient boosting, random forests, clustering, and feature engineering

  • Experience building or modernizing pricing platforms, rating engines, underwriting tools, or internal decision-support software

  • Product-minded problem solving: the ability to turn a messy workflow, technical constraint, or business problem into a clear, prioritized path forward - with a track record of partnering with Product and Engineering teams to ship production-grade tools

  • Strong communication skills - you can explain pricing decisions, tradeoffs, and model outputs clearly to executives, engineers, product teams, and regulators

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment where ownership matters, ambiguity is normal, and AI is part of how work gets done

  • Experience leading pricing work across multiple geographies, products, or regulatory environments is a strong plus

  • Formal actuarial credentials, such as Fellow or Associate of a recognized actuarial society, are a plus

  • Bachelor's degree in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field

  • Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.descriptionHtml:

You'll own our internal system that enables humans and AI to explain complex insurance moments simply, consistently, and at scale. You'll set the bar for what "Lemonade-y" means in practice, and work through the most advanced and nuanced communication challenges we face.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

In this role you'll:

  • Own product voice and communication quality through our internal system, setting the bar for clear, concise copy that reduces friction and turns confusing moments into intuitive ones - getting to the mind and heart of our users to drive real outcomes

  • Define how we use and scale UX copy, support macros, and AI-generated product communication across human and automated channels

  • Continuously improve output quality through training, evaluation, and feedback loops, and monitor copy quality across all product surfaces

  • Experience working with AI writing tools and a genuine curiosity for how automation shapes customer communication

  • An eye for consistency and the ability to build systems, guidelines, and workflows that scale across teams

  • Excellent written English with full professional fluency

  • Ability to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Commercial Counsel to help Lemonade close strong deals quickly and safely. You'll join our Legal Team in New York City and work directly with Procurement, Vendor Management, and Growth. You will be the lead negotiator on key commercial agreements and help build systems for managing contracts at scale with AI. Your guidance will shape the agreements that power how we build and grow.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you’ll

  • Draft, review, and negotiate commercial agreements, from SaaS and technology licensing to purchasing, marketing, partnership, and professional services deals

  • Work on strategic transactions, potential acquisitions and partnership agreements

  • Partner with internal teams at every stage, turning legal insight into clear, practical guidance

  • Spot and reduce legal risk before deals close, including data privacy and protection issues

  • Build and maintain playbooks and templates to move fast

  • Help oversee our contract management system and improve how contracts move from request to signature

  • Build LegalTech AI tools and automations with our IT partners

  • Support special projects, legal research, and ad hoc needs across the Legal Team

What you’ll need

  • 4+ years of experience in corporate and commercial law, including complex contracts, with experience negotiating enterprise SaaS, licensing, and professional services agreements

  • A bachelor's degree and a JD from an accredited law school, plus bar admission in good standing (New York preferred)

  • In-house experience at global tech companies is a plus

  • Hands-on experience with AI tools, including AI-assisted drafting, redlining, and issue spotting

  • Working knowledge of privacy frameworks such as the California Consumer Privacy Act and the General Data Protection Regulation, and familiarity with intellectual property is a plus

  • Skill at translating legal risk into business terms for non-legal stakeholders, and the ability to manage many concurrent negotiations independently

  • Ready to work in our Soho office 3 days per week

*Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Lemonade's US base salary range for this full-time position is $200,000 - $225,000 plus equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our competitive total rewards package includes comprehensive health & wellness coverage, equity, a 401(k) plan with employer match, 20 paid vacation days, and parental leave. Speak to your recruiter to hear more about the specific salary range for your preferred location and our total rewards package.

jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior AI Data Scientist to help push Lemonade's pricing models into genuinely new territory. You'll sit within our Data Science Pricing team, working closely with Actuarial and Insurance Product to develop and deploy predictive models across our Home, Renters, Car, and Pet lines — in multiple countries. This isn't a research-only role. You'll own projects end-to-end, from scoping the business problem through production deployment, and you'll help set the technical bar for the data scientists around you.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Research and apply advanced ML and AI solutions to real pricing and underwriting problems — not just prototype them, but get them into production

  • Own projects end-to-end, from high-level business strategy through deployment, driving alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Collaborate with the Insurance team to develop, file, implement, and monitor new predictive models across Home, Renters, Car, and Pet products

  • Mentor junior data scientists and establish technical standards that raise the bar across the team

  • Champion the adoption of advanced data science practices throughout the broader Insurance organization

What you'll need

  • 3-4+ years of hands-on production data science experience, including end-to-end ownership of multiple models built and deployed in production

  • Fluency in Python for both software development and model building, plus strong SQL skills working with large datasets

  • Demonstrated ability to scope and structure technical solutions from ambiguous business problems — independently, without waiting for the problem to be handed to you pre-packaged

  • Proven impact beyond your own deliverables — infrastructure, tooling, or standards others actually adopted

  • Deep familiarity with the current AI and ML landscape, and a genuine drive to push its application further

  • Must be able to handle the full pipeline, from business case and data wrangling to feature engineering, build, production deployment, and monitoring

  • Experience in InsurTech or FinTech is a plus

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field preferred—or a Bachelor’s degree/equivalent practical experience with a strong track record of applied data science

  • Ability to work in our SoHo, NYC office 3 days per week

Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants from these states: Alaska, California, Colorado, Montana, Hawaii, New Mexico and Puerto Rico.

Our competitive total rewards package includes comprehensive health & wellness coverage, equity, a 401(k) plan with employer match, 20 paid vacation days, and parental leave. Speak to your recruiter to hear more about the specific salary range for your preferred location and our total rewards package.

jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for an Accounting Manager to take ownership of Lemonade's parent company accounting operations and help drive greater efficiency, accuracy, and transparency across our financial ecosystem. You'll sit within our Finance team, leading the month-end close process, managing a broad range of financial schedules, and acting as a key partner to our Controller and Director of Technical Accounting on SEC reporting and audit deliverables. This is a high-ownership role that touches nearly every corner of the business — from intercompany transactions to share-based compensation to lease accounting.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Lead the month-end close process for Lemonade Inc., Agency, and Life Agency — including P&L analytics, vendor breakdown reviews, and detailed expense reviews across entities

  • Manage all parent company accrual schedules, including contract and vendor accruals, professional and legal fee schedules, and underwriting expenses

  • Own share-based compensation accounting in partnership with Fidelity — preparing entries for all subsidiaries, footnote disclosures, and recording of stock option exercises

  • Oversee intercompany relationships, settlement of transactions, translation true-ups, and cost-plus relationship recording

  • Manage ASC 842 lease schedules in Trullion, prepare monthly entries, and support lease disclosure preparation

  • Lead the organization and delivery of year-end and quarterly audit procedures, and support annual SOX testing

  • Support the Controller and Director of Technical Accounting in quarterly SEC financial reporting — including financial reporting packages, footnote and disclosure preparation, and audit review support

  • Act as Finance-level AP approver for the vast majority of invoices, ensuring accuracy and appropriate tagging before escalation to cost center managers

  • Run monthly allocations, prepare allocation review schedules, reperform occupancy calculations, and support monthly GAAP ULAE entries

  • Partner cross-functionally with Business Development, Offline Media, Production, and Growth Development on financial operations including invoices, accruals, and processing

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience in public or private accounting, with demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-entity close processes

  • Strong command of U.S. GAAP, including working knowledge of ASC 842, share-based compensation, intercompany accounting, and SEC reporting requirements

  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills

  • Experience with Workday ERP is a plus

  • Comfortable operating across multiple entities and legal structures simultaneously

  • Sharp attention to detail with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines without dropping the ball

  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

  • Ability to work in our Soho, NYC office 3 days per week

 

Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants from these states: Alaska, California, Colorado, Montana, Hawaii, New Mexico and Puerto Rico.

Our competitive total rewards package includes comprehensive health & wellness coverage, equity, a 401(k) plan with employer match, 20 paid vacation days, and parental leave. jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior Product Designer who combines strong product thinking, UX, and visual craft with genuine curiosity about how AI is changing what we build — and how we build it.

Designers at Lemonade work across customer-facing products, complex internal systems, design systems, and AI-powered experiences. You'll own projects end-to-end, collaborate closely across disciplines, and help explore new approaches to designing and building great products. This role sits within our Product Design team, based in Tel Aviv. Please only apply if you have an up-to-date online portfolio showcasing recent work.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

We don't expect designers to know every tool or model. We do expect genuine curiosity — using AI in your process, designing experiences that couldn't exist without it, and staying open to rethinking the work, not just accelerating it.

In this role you'll

  • Create delightful user-facing products across web and mobile, turning complex problems into simple, intuitive experiences

  • Own the design process end-to-end — from understanding the problem and exploring solutions through validation and implementation

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Data, and QA to shape products and drive decisions

  • Design AI-powered experiences and explore where AI can fundamentally improve a product, workflow, or experience

  • Use AI throughout your own design process to explore, build, iterate, and work more effectively

  • Design complex internal systems and contribute to the evolution of our design systems

  • Share strong product and design perspectives, and help raise the quality and capabilities of the wider design team

What you'll need

  • 5+ years of experience designing digital products, with a portfolio demonstrating product thinking, UX, visual craft, and end-to-end ownership

  • Strong product thinking, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, simplify complex problems, and make thoughtful trade-offs

  • Excellent visual and interaction design skills, with strong attention to detail and mastery of Figma and prototyping

  • Experience creating and working with design systems

  • Hands-on experience using AI as part of your design or product development process

  • Curiosity to go beyond prompting — experimenting with AI, building new workflows, prototyping with it, and exploring how it changes both products and the way you work

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to take ownership and drive projects forward independently

  • A background in Visual Communication is an advantage — illustration, animation, motion, or coding skills are a plus too

  • Ability to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior Compliance Analyst to help build and strengthen compliance processes across Lemonade's growing portfolio of P&C insurance products. You'll sit within our Compliance team, supporting leaders and partnering with Insurance Operations and Product to monitor existing processes, stand up new ones, and make sure we're operating compliantly across Car, Home, Renters, and Pet — in an increasingly complex state regulatory environment. This role calls for someone who's organized, sharp, and confident translating regulatory complexity into clear, actionable guidance.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Build and implement new compliance processes from scratch — structured, efficient, and built to scale

  • Develop policies and procedures that streamline operations and keep pace with regulatory requirements across all P&C lines

  • Provide compliance guidance, coaching, and feedback to key leadership as Lemonade continues to grow across Car, Home, Renters, and Pet products

  • Build strong working relationships across Compliance, Insurance Operations, and Product, and with colleagues across the broader business

  • Drive continuous improvement through AI and automation, finding smarter ways to manage compliance at scale

  • Manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines without letting standards or attention to detail slip

  • Support company-wide compliance projects as they arise

What you'll need

  • 4+ years of P&C personal lines insurance compliance or risk management experience

  • Demonstrated persuasive writing skills — able to communicate issues clearly and translate technical and insurance requirements for different audiences

  • Strong organizational skills, with comfort managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

  • Working knowledge of risk management principles across any line of business

  • Fluency with G-Suite and Slack as everyday work tools

  • A bachelor's degree in Business, Insurance, Risk Management, or a related field is a plus

  • Ability to work in a remote environment

Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants from these states: Alaska, California, Colorado, Montana, Hawaii, New Mexico and Puerto Rico.

Lemonade's US base salary range for this full-time position is $90,000 - $103,500 plus equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our competitive total rewards package includes comprehensive health & wellness coverage, equity, a 401(k) plan with employer match, 20 paid vacation days, and parental leave. Speak to your recruiter to hear more about the specific salary range for your preferred location and our total rewards package.

jobs.title: Director of Business Technology & AI Ops
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Director of Business Technology & AI Ops to help Lemonade turn AI into real results for our business teams. You'll identify high-impact opportunities and lead the delivery of scalable solutions with measurable business outcomes.

As we build a more autonomous, AI-first company, you'll help shape our business technology direction - from enterprise platforms to AI-native solutions—and work across business teams, IT, and Product & Engineering to align the right capabilities and approach for each opportunity.

We believe two things matter for every leadership role at Lemonade: leadership that sets the bar for excellence, builds high performing teams, and holds them accountable, and strategy that thinks several years ahead and turns ambitious plans into reality. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Partner with Customer Operations and Revenue leaders to understand their goals, economics, and workflows, and shape a technology roadmap focused on measurable business impact.

  • Lead the redesign of workflows through AI agents, automation, and software to improve performance and build more autonomous operations.

  • Work across business teams, IT, and Product & Engineering to align on the right approach and ownership for each initiative, balancing speed, scalability, cost, and long-term value.

  • Lead the business technology and AI initiative portfolio: prioritize opportunities, track investments and ROI, drive adoption, and ensure solutions deliver the expected outcomes.

  • Shape the evolution of platforms such as Zendesk, Talkdesk, Twilio, and Revenue applications in partnership with business and technology leaders, identifying opportunities to simplify, consolidate, or introduce AI-native alternatives.

  • Build and lead a strong team, defining the capabilities and operating model needed to deliver scalable solutions alongside IT and Product & Engineering.

What you'll need

  • 7+ years leading business transformation, technology strategy, or complex cross-functional initiatives, ideally in consulting, business operations, or a tech-driven environment.

  • Sharp business instincts and structured problem-solving, with the ability to spot what drives performance in complex operations.

  • Hands-on understanding of AI, including large language models, agents, and automation, and how to apply them to real business problems.

  • Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, data, and enterprise platforms, enough to evaluate solutions and work well with engineers.

  • A track record of taking initiatives from idea to adoption and measurable results, including through teams you don't manage.

  • Executive-level communication and stakeholder skills, with the confidence to challenge assumptions and align senior leaders.

  • Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to help shape the future of how we design at Lemonade — not just by doing great work, but by raising the bar for everyone around you.

This role sits within our Product Design team, based in Tel Aviv. You'll take on the broadest, most complex design challenges we have — owning them end-to-end, driving decisions across teams and disciplines, and influencing how we think about product and design at a company level.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

We don't expect designers to know every tool or model. We do expect genuine curiosity — using AI in your process, designing experiences that couldn't exist without it, and staying open to rethinking the work, not just accelerating it.

In this role you'll

  • Lead the design of our most complex, high-impact product areas — owning scope end-to-end from problem definition through delivery

  • Drive decisions across Product, Engineering, Data, and leadership, bringing design perspective into the room early and often

  • Mentor and elevate designers across the team — through feedback, collaboration, and raising the standard of what great work looks like

  • Communicate clearly and confidently to all audiences — from teammates to senior leadership, internally and externally

  • Shape how we approach AI-powered experiences, and help the wider team think bigger about what AI makes possible

  • Contribute to the strategic direction of our design systems and set the quality bar for craft across the team

  • Spot gaps in how we work and take ownership of fixing them — whether that's process, tooling, or how design shows up in the product org

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience designing digital products, with a portfolio that demonstrates strategic thinking, exceptional craft, and measurable impact at scale

  • A track record of owning large, complex scopes end-to-end — from ambiguous problem to shipped product

  • Comfortable navigating complex organizations, aligning stakeholders, and moving work forward across disciplines

  • Strong mentorship instincts — you make the designers around you better, and you're intentional about it

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present work, advocate for decisions, and inspire confidence in any room

  • Hands-on experience using AI as part of your design or product development process, and genuine curiosity about where it's taking the craft

  • Ability to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.title: Automation Engineer, Billing Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
What you're applying for

We're looking for an Automation-First QA Engineer to help us build quality into the Billing Platform from the ground up. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, automation, and AI — and it's core to how our Engineering team ships fast without breaking things. You'll own quality strategy for your domain and shape the tools, frameworks, and systems that let developers and AI agents move at full speed.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Own quality strategy for the Billing Platform — setting the vision while empowering developers to lead day-to-day quality in their code

  • Build and evolve automated testing solutions across Web, API, and end-to-end user flows

  • Design tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that make quality faster, more scalable, and more autonomous

  • Use AI agents and prompt engineering to improve test creation, coverage analysis, and other parts of the quality lifecycle

  • Partner with developers, Product, and Design to surface risks early and influence technical decisions before they become costly ones

  • Translate quality data and delivery signals into clear recommendations on gaps, priorities, and readiness

  • Drive quality engineering best practices across the organization — not just within your own domain

What you'll need

  • 4+ years of experience as a QA Engineer or Software Engineer in Test

  • Strong coding skills in at least one modern language — TypeScript, Python, or similar

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or comparable modern automation frameworks

  • Experience designing end-to-end testing strategies across Web, API, and data layers

  • A builder mindset — you turn ideas into tools and frameworks, not just test cases

  • A red team instinct — you challenge assumptions, stress-test decisions, and find the edge cases others miss

  • Familiarity with AI tools, prompt engineering, or AI agents, and genuine curiosity about where they take software quality next

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.title: Director of Talent Acquisition
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a talent leader to oversee our global recruiting strategy and team. As AI transforms the future of work, finding the right people will become more nuanced, focused on identifying what uniquely human skills will take Lemonade to the next level.

This isn’t about filling seats. It’s about understanding what skills drive impact, where the talent market is going, and how AI can absorb the mechanics so you can lead our quest to find “needle in a haystack” talent across the globe.

We believe two things matter for every leadership role at Lemonade: leadership that sets the bar for excellence, builds high performing teams, and holds them accountable, and strategy that thinks several years ahead and turns ambitious plans into reality. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Be a magnet for exceptional talent. Use your strategic thinking and relationship-building superpowers to bring in top talent. Take on our most challenging searches and lead our small but mighty talent team

  • Build a skills-driven talent strategy. Evolve how we assess talent to measure unique human abilities for the things AI can’t, or shouldn’t, handle

  • Forecast like an analyst. Use your analytical thinking and AI fluency to build talent forecasts that inform the business

  • Drive operational excellence. Build efficient, AI-powered recruiting systems. Know the data, unblock your team, communicate effectively, and ship as if we needed it yesterday

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years in talent, people, business development, relationship management, or related fields

  • Experience managing and leading global teams

  • AI appetite, with real examples of how you use AI today

  • Emotional intelligence that lets you move the business in ways AI can’t, and build deep connections with candidates, hiring managers, executives, and other stakeholders

  • Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

Please note that this is a global role. We are open to hiring this position in Tel Aviv or New York City.

jobs.title: Actuary
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for an Actuary to help us reinvent how actuarial work gets done — with AI, automation, and a genuine drive to find smarter ways forward. Based in Amsterdam, you'll sit at the intersection of finance and insurance, owning core reserving and regulatory work while actively building the faster, leaner workflows that will carry Lemonade's European expansion.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Own reserving processes and Solvency II calculations, ensuring accuracy and timeliness across all regulatory submissions

  • Contribute to key financial reporting deliverables — including SFCR, RSR, ORSA, and QRTs — working closely with the wider team to meet regulatory deadlines

What you'll need

  • Familiarity with data science tools like Python or R, and a genuine comfort working alongside AI and automation

  • Experience in financial reporting for regulated insurers

  • The ability to take complex results and communicate them clearly to management and stakeholders

  • Excellent written and verbal English — this is a must

  • Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

jobs.title: Actuarial Associate, UK
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a technically savvy Actuarial Pricing Associate to join the UK team and support pricing adequacy, accuracy, and competitiveness of our European products. You will contribute your actuarial expertise as part of an interdisciplinary team that includes data scientists, insurance Product and Underwriting professionals. Working in collaboration, you’ll help develop and implement new pricing capabilities that blend actuarial approaches with predictive modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.

In this role you’ll

  • Help shape our UK pricing strategy, balancing profitable growth, competitive prices and great customer outcomes.

  • Turn trading data into action, digging into conversion, retention, risk mix and profitability to spot opportunities and explain what’s changing.

  • Build a deep understanding of competitor pricing and our position on price comparison websites, using those insights to improve how we price.

  • Own pricing changes from idea to launch, testing their impact and tracking what happens once they’re live.

  • Partner with Data Science, Product and Underwriting to bring together predictive models, customer behaviour and commercial insight.

  • Bring your UK insurance expertise to our global team, sharing knowledge and challenging assumptions to help us make better decisions.

  • Help build a faster, smarter pricing engine through automation, experimentation and thoughtful use of AI.

  • Further your actuarial education through industry research and stay on top of changing regulatory requirements

What you’ll need

  • 3–5 years of UK personal lines pricing experience, including hands-on commercial or street pricing.

  • A strong understanding of how the UK insurance market works, with practical experience of price comparison websites, competitor pricing and customer behaviour.

  • A track record of turning analysis into pricing changes that deliver measurable results.

  • Strong SQL and Python or R skills, with confidence exploring data independently and checking that your conclusions hold up.

  • Commercial judgement and curiosity: you ask good questions, challenge assumptions and connect the numbers to what’s happening in the market.

  • Clear communication skills and enthusiasm for sharing your UK market knowledge with colleagues across the business.

  • Working knowledge of UK pricing/insurance regulations

  • Enthusiasm for learning and working with AI, and exploring how it can improve the way we price and work.

  • UK home pricing experience is a strong plus, as are actuarial qualifications and experience with demand modelling or optimisation.

  • Ability to work from our London office.

  • Commitment in obtaining FIA (Fellow of the Institute of Actuaries) or FFA (Fellow of the Faculty of Actuaries)

  • Master’s degree in mathematics / econometrics / actuarial science / related field preferred

jobs.title: Senior Director of Brand Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior Director of Brand Marketing to own what Lemonade stands for, protect what makes it unmistakable, and make sure brand thinking shapes the biggest decisions the company makes - not just the assets that come after.

You'll balance long-term brand building with short-term commercial impact, and serve as the executive voice on everything brand - across every market, channel, and touchpoint we operate in. This role sits at the center of the Marketing team, partnering directly with our founders and executive leadership.

Two things matter for every leadership role at Lemonade: leadership that sets the bar for excellence, builds high-performing teams, and holds them accountable, and strategy that thinks several years ahead and turns ambitious plans into reality. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Own the Lemonade brand end-to-end positioning, narrative, voice, and brand systems and act as the final internal authority on what's on-brand across every consumer touchpoint globally

  • Be the company's go-to person for brand, helping founders, executives, and cross-functional leaders make decisions that strengthen the brand, the business, and the customer experience

  • Lead world-class integrated campaigns from strategy through execution, including creative direction, external director and studio selection, and the executive feedback loop

  • Own the end-to-end production of brand and OOH campaigns - from briefing and vendor management through delivery, measurement, and iteration - ensuring creative work ships at scale and on time

  • Drive operational excellence across the creative function, building the systems, processes, and workflows that allow the team to deliver high-quality work consistently and efficiently

  • Create non-traditional brand activations, experiential moments, partnerships, and cultural ideas that make Lemonade more visible, more relevant, and harder to forget

  • Own global brand strategy, including localization, cultural adaptation, market-specific briefs, and the systems that keep Lemonade consistent as it grows

  • Define and track the brand health metrics that matter - awareness, consideration, distinctiveness, and mental availability - and turn those learnings into smarter strategy, priorities, and budget decisions

  • Build and lead the brand and creative team, setting the creative bar, running senior hiring, and mentoring the next generation of creative talent at Lemonade

What you'll need

  • You've built a distinctive consumer brand at a top-tier company or agency - people remember the work, and the work moved the business

  • A proven track record leading major integrated campaigns from concept to screen, working with external directors, production partners, agencies, and internal creative teams

  • Demonstrated operational experience managing large-scale creative production - OOH, brand, and integrated campaigns - with a strong grasp of timelines, budgets, and vendor relationships

  • Experience building or improving creative operations infrastructure: workflows, briefing systems, production pipelines, and cross-functional collaboration models

  • Exceptional taste and judgment - you can articulate exactly why brand work is or isn't working, and hold the bar without doing the work yourself

  • The ability to turn complex products into simple, human stories and make strong strategic decisions with incomplete information

  • Experience scaling brand footprints internationally, with real sensitivity to cultural nuance and what should or shouldn't change

  • The ability to influence and align founders, executives, and senior cross-functional partners around a single brand vision

  • You understand brand measurement well enough to connect decisions to business outcomes, without reducing the brand to a dashboard

  • Strong leadership skills with a track record of hiring, developing, and inspiring senior creative talent

  • Ready to work in our Soho office three times per week

*Please note that we are unable to sponsor applicants for work visas.

Unfortunately, we cannot consider applicants from these states: Alaska, California, Colorado, Montana, Hawaii, New Mexico and Puerto Rico.

Lemonade's US base salary range for this full-time position is $260,000 - $310,000 plus equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our competitive total rewards package includes comprehensive health & wellness coverage, equity, a 401(k) plan with employer match, 20 paid vacation days, and parental leave. Speak to your recruiter to hear more about the specific salary range for your preferred location and our total rewards package.

jobs.title: Actuary, UK
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a technically savvy Pricing Actuary to join the UK team and support pricing adequacy, accuracy, and competitiveness of our European products. You will contribute your actuarial expertise as part of an interdisciplinary team that includes data scientists, insurance Product and Underwriting professionals. Working in collaboration, you’ll help develop and implement new pricing capabilities that blend actuarial approaches with predictive modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.

In this role you’ll

  • Help shape our UK pricing strategy, balancing profitable growth, competitive prices and great customer outcomes.

  • Recommend pricing and underwriting actions based on ongoing performance monitoring and competitive analysis

  • Build a deep understanding of competitor pricing and our position on price comparison websites, using those insights to improve how we price.

  • Own pricing changes from idea to launch, testing their impact and tracking what happens once they’re live.

  • Partner with Data Science, Product and Underwriting to bring together predictive models, customer behaviour and commercial insight.

  • Bring your UK insurance expertise to our global team, sharing knowledge and challenging assumptions to help us make better decisions.

  • Help build a faster, smarter pricing engine through automation, experimentation and thoughtful use of AI.

  • Further your actuarial education through industry research and stay on top of changing regulatory requirements

What you’ll need

  • 5-7 years of UK personal lines pricing experience, including hands-on commercial or street pricing.

  • Fellow of the Institute and Faculty of Actuaries (IFoA)

  • A strong understanding of how the UK insurance market works, with practical experience of price comparison websites, competitor pricing and customer behaviour.

  • A track record of turning analysis into pricing changes that deliver measurable results.

  • Strong SQL and Python or R skills, with confidence exploring data independently and checking that your conclusions hold up.

  • Commercial judgement and curiosity: you ask good questions, challenge assumptions and connect the numbers to what’s happening in the market.

  • Clear communication skills and enthusiasm for sharing your UK market knowledge with colleagues across the business.

  • Working knowledge of UK pricing/insurance regulations

  • UK home pricing experience is a strong plus, as is experience with demand modelling or optimisation.

  • Enthusiasm for learning and working with AI, and exploring how it can improve the way we price and work.Ability to work from our London office.

  • Master’s degree in mathematics / econometrics / actuarial science / related field preferred

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for a Senior Analyst to help us strengthen our reinsurance process. You'll sit within our Finance team, driving automation, transparency, and efficiency across global reinsurance accounting and reporting, from day-to-day bookings to the systems that help us scale.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

  • Analyze monthly assumed and ceded reinsurance bookings, and prepare manual entries when needed

  • Build assumed and ceded analytics that explain significant monthly fluctuations

  • Support the rollout of new reinsurance contracts into our accounting infrastructure

  • Review reinsurance agreements for risk transfer and proper accounting treatment

  • Support the placement of new reinsurance treaties alongside Underwriting, Actuarial, and other teams

  • Find automated solutions to reinsurance operational complexity and challenge the status quo

  • Prepare accurate, on-time reinsurance bordereaux and reporting

  • Work with auditors and stakeholders to keep us compliant

  • Manage cash settlement with cedents and reinsurers

  • Complete quarterly Schedule F, Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL), and other regulatory reporting for our reinsurance programs

  • Monitor collateral needs, including funds held and letters of credit

  • Maintain documentation for processes, operating controls, and SOX controls

What you'll need

  • 4+ years of P&C accounting or finance experience

  • Knowledge of US GAAP and US Statutory accounting

  • Ability to build strong partnerships with stakeholders inside and outside the company

  • Project management skills, and the ability to juggle multiple responsibilities and deadlines

  • Experience with reinsurance, LLMs, IFRS, or implementing system solutions is a plus

  • Workday ERP experience and a CPA are preferred

  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance

  • Ability to work in our SoHo, NYC office 3 days per week
